sourceFacts: Server serves fixed public-file allowlist and no-store response headers.
Summary includes schema version1, generatedAt and registryFingerprint, but none of these identifies the page asset version.
Client refresh fetches summary and assignments, updates author facts, and repeats every20s when visible; it does not reload the loaded page modules.
candidateRequirement: Keep author-data synchronization status and loaded-interface version separate; if a newer deployed interface is observed, offer an explicit update action without silently closing an open detail or resetting selection.
acceptanceIdeas: Version is derived from the actual served asset set, not changing status files or metadata-only Git commits.
No new per-poll Git scan, artifact inventory or provider call. Reuse a bounded current response where appropriate.
Coherence must be defined if assets change on disk while an old server remains running; a startup label alone must not misidentify newly served file bytes.
Exercise one open page across an actual controlled asset-version change: data stays current, update prompt appears, no automatic navigation or loss of expanded review.
Missing/unrecognized version remains unknown and does not fabricate stale or current; normal data failures keep their existing meaning.
Explicit update action loads new interface and preserves safe navigation context where supported.
coordination: Candidate for existing D05/dashboard followup plan. Original remains registry/deploy authority; manager checks existing backlog and claims before assigning any implementation. Root does not take it or create a second dashboard.
limits: This is an observed usability gap plus bounded source rationale, not a security finding or a measured performance regression. Historical tab1 staleness cause beyond old loaded page was not investigated.
cleanCode: One derived asset identity, separate from owner status facts; avoid a second editable progress source or broad reload framework.
